feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 1 September 2026 5:04am
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Tuesday, 01 September 2026 at 5:00am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Nil.


##Synopsis##

Low pressure to the north and west of the British Isles, while high pressure over the Bay of Biscay extends a transient ridge across the area, tracking eastwards today.


##Wind##

Southwest 4 or 5, decreasing 3 or 4 for a time in the west this evening, then backing Southerly overnight.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate.


##Weather##

Isolated showers, becoming scattered this evening, then rain spreads from the west tomorrow morning.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate in showers, falling moderate or poor in rain later.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

Southerly 3 to 5, veering Southwest 4 or 5 tomorrow evening, then increasing West 5 or 6 later.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate.


##Weather##

Rain spreads from the west, clearing to isolated showers tomorrow afternoon.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate or poor in rain or showers.
